The '''Flight Unlimited Group Base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lankor VI]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the FUG had control of the planet. The base was located 75 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Rham'Dhaam]], within a large [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]. There, they developed a prototype [[Starship/Legends|starship]] called the ''[[Trait Luminique]]''. It possessed incredible energy boosters and a powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
